comment: The B knob is read whatever is patched, but drift_core.vult line 133 sets the blend amount to zero unless the input jack is connected, so with nothing patched the knob has no effect on the output. The speed range is 0.01Hz to 6Hz: drift_core.vult line 33 raises e to 6.396929655 times the shaped knob, which is a factor of 600.
